verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no app marketplace and no prebuilt, installable integrations for Slack, support desk, marketing, or data-warehouse tools. It shows only developer building blocks (REST APIs, SDKs, Widget SDK) and a Zia Agent Store for AI agents, which is an adjacent feature and not an integrations marketplace. An integrations marketplace is a fair axis for a CRM, so the absence of evidence yields "none", not "na".

support.subject: As an ops user, I can install prebuilt integrations (Slack, support desk, marketing, data warehouse) from an app marketplace
